description.narrative: ALIGN supports governments, civil society, local communities and other relevant actors in strengthening the governance of land-based investments

Objective: To improve the governance and practices of land-based investments in specific focus countries, as well as globally, leading over time to: • Closer alignment between land-based investments and development priorities; • Respect for the land and human rights of people affected by investment processes; •Enhanced livelihoods, incomes and opportunities for post-COVID economic recoveryin affected countries and sites; • Environmental sustainability at local and national scales; and •Improved participation and representation of communities, and of citizens more generally, in decision-making concerning land-based investments.
The initiative will support governments, civil society, local communities and private sector actors in improving the governance and practices of land-based investments.
